decision.reason: The newly closed 35s/794s pair yields only 4.22% utilization. Together with prior short-run evidence, voluntary handoff in the tens-of-seconds region remains dominated by boundary idle cost. No optimum cutoff is inferred; the treatment variable remains completed same-wake useful-work duration only.
